# Initial Set Up
```{r}
# initial set up
library(randomForest)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
source("../scripts/preprocessing.R")
set.seed(110122)
```

# Preprocessing

```{r}
# load cleaned data
load('../data/claims-clean-example.RData')
```

```{r}
# using default preprocessing
claims <- nlp_fn(claims_clean) %>%
  left_join(claims_clean %>% select(.id, mclass), by = ".id") %>%
  select(-bclass)
```

## Removing Rare Tokens
```{r}
token_cols <- setdiff(names(claims), c(".id", "mclass"))

# removes tokens that appear less than or equal to 7 times 
token_keep <- token_cols[colSums(claims[token_cols] > 0) >= 7]

claims_filtered <- claims %>% select(.id, mclass, all_of(token_keep))
```

# Random Forest Model Training

## Intial Split
```{r}
# splitting data into train and test
partitions <- claims_filtered %>%
  initial_split(prop = 0.8, strata = mclass)

train_text <- training(partitions)
train_x <- train_text %>% select(-.id, -mclass)
train_y <- train_text$mclass

test_text <- testing(partitions) 
test_x <- test_text %>% select(-.id, -mclass)
test_y <- test_text$mclass 
```

## Tuning mtry
```{r}
# tune <- tuneRF(x = train_x, y = train_y,, ntreeTry = 113, stepFactor = 1.25, 
               # improve = 0.01, trace = T, plot = F)

# tune

# selecting best mtry
mtry_best <- 55
```

## Fitting Model (takes a bit to load)
```{r}
rf_fit <- randomForest(x = train_x, y = train_y, mtry = mtry_best, ntree = 500, importance = T)
```

# Accuracy 
```{r}
pred_class <- predict(rf_fit, test_x)

mean(pred_class == test_y)
table(predicted = pred_class, actual = test_y)
```

# Saving Model and Training Data
```{r}
save(rf_fit, file = "../results/multi-class-model.RData")

save(train_text, test_text, file = "../data/test-train-multi-class.RData")
```
